components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's optional honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it drives the derived salutation. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured address fields are supplied they take precedence. Returned as the composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a single space and normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input. Stored and returned normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g. unit or apartment). Stored and returned normalized; when present it is appended to addressLine1 (separated by a single space) to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit value. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional. When present, it drives the derived ageBand (computed against the registrationDate). Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode), so a second owner with the same lastName and postcode is otherwise rejected with 409 as a household duplicate. When true, this flag only bypasses that duplicate block, declaring this owner an acknowledged member of the household; a declared member is NOT flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create or assign the householdId, which is derived deterministically from (lastName, postcode). Not stored or returned (see the read-only householdId).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, derived as the title followed by a single space and the lastName when a title was supplied, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when it resolves to no known region) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year it starts in.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year it starts in, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July takes that year and an earlier one takes the previous year; YY is the last two digits of that start year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the REGION prefix of the customerCode, i.e. the region derived from the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known range.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality via the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or null when the locality has no pinned timezone.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household, formed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same lastName and postcode share it automatically. Null when the owner has no postcode (no household to key on).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '1a2b3c4d5e6f'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection identity, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's; the former separate telephone, email and household duplicate checks are all expressed through this one key.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61400000001||'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's optional honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it drives the derived salutation. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured address fields are supplied they take precedence. Returned as the composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a single space and normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input. Stored and returned normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g. unit or apartment). Stored and returned normalized; when present it is appended to addressLine1 (separated by a single space) to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit value. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional. When present, it drives the derived ageBand (computed against the registrationDate). Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode), so a second owner with the same lastName and postcode is otherwise rejected with 409 as a household duplicate. When true, this flag only bypasses that duplicate block, declaring this owner an acknowledged member of the household; a declared member is NOT flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create or assign the householdId, which is derived deterministically from (lastName, postcode). Not stored or returned (see the read-only householdId).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, derived as the title followed by a single space and the lastName when a title was supplied, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', unifying the former customerCode and membershipNumber. REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when it resolves to no known region); FY is the two-digit fiscal-year start year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year it starts in); HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName); CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year it starts in, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July takes that year and an earlier one takes the previous year; YY is the last two digits of that start year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the REGION prefix of the customerCode, i.e. the region derived from the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known range.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality via the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or null when the locality has no pinned timezone.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household, formed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same lastName and postcode share it automatically. Null when the owner has no postcode (no household to key on).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '1a2b3c4d5e6f'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection identity, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. A create is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's; the former separate telephone, email and household duplicate checks are all expressed through this one key.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61400000001||'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 other owners share this owner's effective (business-day) registration date, i.e. more than 80 owners were already created that day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone; otherwise false. A declared household member (created with sharesHousehold) is exempt and never flagged. Set at creation time and retained.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible duplicate of. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when, at the time this owner was created, its city already held between 40 and 49 other owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50, beyond which a create is rejected with 409); otherwise false. Set at creation time and retained.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record, after which the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore this owner.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived as 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against registrationDate - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Present only when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, formed as '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
            pets:
              title: Pets

              type: array

              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, removed the standalone `checkDigit` field, and updated all consumers. The full test suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1/1 passing, whole project compiles).

**New / renamed:**
- **`MemberId.java`** (new model, replacing `CustomerCode`) — single source of truth. `format(region, fy, hash8)` concatenates `REGION+FY+HASH8` and appends a Luhn `CHK` over that base; `hash8(...)` is the unchanged SHA-256-first-8-upper-hex over `normalizedTelephone+lastName`; `region(memberId)` recovers REGION as the leading non-digit run (the FY that follows is always digits); `checkDigit(...)` is the Luhn routine.
- **`AssignMemberId.java`** (renamed from `AssignCustomerCode`) — now pulls FY from `FiscalYear.twoDigitStartYear(registrationDate)`, builds the memberId, and applies collision handling against existing `memberId`s (`-2`, `-3`, …).

**Removed:** `CustomerCode.java`, `MembershipNumber.java`, `AssignCustomerCode.java`.

**Edited:**
- `Owner.java` — field/column/getter/setter `customerCode`→`memberId` (`member_id`); DB schemas (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres) column renamed.
- `OwnerMapper.java` — dropped `checkDigit` and `membershipNumber` mappings; `memberId` now auto-maps; `locality`/`timezone` derive from `MemberId.region(owner.getMemberId())`.
- `OwnerSegment.java`, `Regions.java`, `OwnerPrimaryIdentifier.java`, `FiscalYear.java` — repointed to `MemberId`/`memberId`.
- `AuditOwnerCreated.java` + `OwnerCreatedEvent.java` — audit line and event component now reference `memberId`.
- `owners.POST.yml` — pipeline step points at `AssignMemberId`.
- `openapi.yml` — removed the three field schemas, added a `memberId` schema, and fixed the `locality` description. (`OwnerDto` is generated from this spec, so this is what drops the old JSON fields and adds the new one.)

One design note worth flagging: the member-id format has no separator, so collision disambiguation appends `-<n>` to the full id (e.g. `NSW261A2B3C4D7-2`) — region parsing still works since it reads the leading letters. No existing test exercises collisions, but I kept the behavior sensible and documented it.
